# protected area

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayTypeProtectedArea`](gmeow-overlayTypeProtectedArea.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayTypeProtectedArea>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A legally-designated protected area such as a national park, wildlife reserve, marine protected area, or wilderness area. Management categories (IUCN Ia–VI) are carried as additional classifications, not as subclasses.
